bank_cfads_treatment.conclusion: CF row 69 (Free Cash Flow for Banks) explicitly includes G66 (reserve/cash interest income). Bank CFADS includes both unrestricted cash interest (P&L!G20) and reserve account interest (P&L!G19).

dsra_account_eligibility.conclusion: DSRA (CF81) and J-DSRA (CF95) are ELIGIBLE accounts in the workbook formula. Current balance is zero for all periods. INELIGIBLE classification was incorrect — accounts are eligible but happen to have zero balance.
